title: New users
summary: Assign a new-user episode roster using the recipe language's standard drug-era and washout definition. First-eligible selection can retain a later eligible course after an earlier ineligible candidate. Ingredient mapping and same-day candidate order are deterministic. A zero washout means no washout or prior-observation requirement, not a claim of incident use.
